calculation.description: Cross-sectionally rank lagged 60-session realized volatility; higher values receive higher factor scores and are expected to have higher subsequent 10-session returns. Uses close prices only and no future information.

validation.period: 2025-01-02 through 2035-05-09 (available aligned observations; full history begins after warmup)

metrics.ic_convention: daily cross-sectional Spearman IC mean and mean/std over dates

validation.regime_notes: Positive signed IC in mid period (2025-2029: +0.02836, ICIR +0.09506), late period (2030-2035: +0.03974, ICIR +0.13102), and recent 365 days (+0.02754, ICIR +0.08001). Small 15-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.

signal_provenance.source_signal: negative 60-day realized volatility; persisted factor reverses sign to high volatility
signal_provenance.artifact_note: Validation script computes the exact source series, forward returns, date-level Spearman IC, turnover, and decay without using future data.
